```{r}
library(glue)
library(fs)
```

```{r}
#| label: download-functions

paris_api_export <- "https://opendata.paris.fr/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/{name}/exports/{format}"
paris_api_attachement <- "https://opendata.paris.fr/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/{name}/attachments/{att}"

dl_parquet <- function(dataset, filename) {
  p <- path("DATA", filename, ext = "parquet")
  if (!file_exists(p)) {
    message(glue("Downloading {filename}"))
    download.file(glue(paris_api_export, name = dataset, format = "parquet"), p)
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: download

if (!dir_exists("DATA")) {
  message(glue("Creating directory DATA in {getwd()}"))
  dir_create("DATA")
}

parquets <- c(
  pres_2007_1 = "elections-presidentielles-2007-1ertour",
  pres_2007_2 = "elections-presidentielles-2007-2emetour",
  pres_2017_1 = "elections-presidentielles-2017-1ertour",
  pres_2017_2 = "elections-presidentielles-2017-2emetour",
  pres_2022_1 = "elections-presidentielles2022-1ertour",
  pres_2022_2 = "elections-presidentielles-2022-2emetour",
  euro_2014 = "elections-europeennes-2014",
  euro_2024 = "elections-europeennes-2024"
)

for (filename in names(parquets)) {
  dl_parquet(parquets[[filename]], filename)
}
```
